text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's properly introduce
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm Aston Machan. Nice to meet
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she looks at me with a shy smile, I
notice my reflection in her
glistening,
round eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We met a few days earlier...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another trainer and I had come to tryouts
looking for new racers to
scout. There was
more of a bustle among the audience than
usual...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: This is the newcomer special, New Paka! Today we're at Tracen Academy to introduce all of you at home to the most talented up-and-coming Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The TV crew really came! The racers must
be excited... No, actually,
they all look
pretty nervous.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The only one who looks calm is Aston
Machan. Wow, she's got nerves
of steel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow my colleague's gaze to find a
certain racer. Despite the tense

atmosphere, she's softly smiling as she
enters the gate.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now, the moment of truth! They're coming
into the final straight! Who
will be first to
make a move?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Aston Machan! With her unique short
stride, she takes the lead!
Aston Machan,
with a margin of half a length... She wins it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Whew... Hehe, peace!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's interview them as they come
off the field. Starting with
the winner,
Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hi everyone, I'm Aston Machan. Nice to
meet you!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: A-Aston Machan! Um, hello! I'm from New Paka. Congrats on a fantastic race!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did you see me? I kind of went all out.
...Oh, this is a Machan doll.
Hellooo!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, um, what a cute doll! So, have you
decided on a trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I haven't. No one's turned
up yet.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?! After that race, though, I'm
sure you'll get plenty of
offers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if on cue, a crowd of trainers gathers
around Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan! Please allow me to train
you! I'll make the best training
plan to suit
your running style!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
P-please consider me too! I won't let that
natural talent of yours go to
waste. I'll
help you reach your full potential!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Okay, make sure we're getting
this. We might be about to
witness the
moment she makes a contract!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now the ball is in newcomer Aston
Machan's court. How will she
respond to
the many trainers before her?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What are your dreams, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Ah... well, of course, mine is to win
G1 races with you!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to make you Umamusume of
the Year! I'll help you rise to
the top of
your generation!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm... Hmm... Hm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
...I see. Bye, then!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-wait! I mean, of course I want to get to
know you too! What's your
dream?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My dream... is to become a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: ...A mascot?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Not just any mascot. I want to be a super
mascot known all over the
world.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I want to appear everywhere, by everybody's side, and be a super—no—a super ultra mascot!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: R-right...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, now you see. Well, I'll be going then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Aston Machan walks away, the crowd is
left standing there in
bewilderment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sensed a special talent when I saw her
quick stride, but it's her
fascinating aura
that leaves the biggest impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm on my way home from the tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hi, there. Would you mind holding the
camera for me, please?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. Could you take a video of us
singing here in the central
plaza? I
completely forgot to bring my tripod.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now, hold on just a second—I never
agreed to this! What's the point
in singing
Umapyoi Legend here, of all places?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The more videos we have, the better.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's already plenty out there! Besides,
why are you so hell-bent on
taking a
singing video anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because I've never taken one before, so.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, c'mon... You're not gonna give up,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She gets pretty stubborn, doesn't she...
Fine, let's hurry up and record
it so we can
go home.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother you, but would you mind?
She's really... you know, she
just likes this
kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you! Here, please use this
phone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's see... If you could capture from
here to around there, that'd
be great.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's peculiar, at home in front of a
camera, and outstanding on the
racetrack.
Those are my first impressions of Aston
Machan.
